gemini_3x6_split.name: Gemini 3×6 Query Splitter
gemini_3x6_split.description: Splits a research query into 3 sessions × 6 questions for Gemini Deep Research
gemini_3x6_split.system_message: You are a research question generator. Given a topic, create exactly 18 research questions organized into 3 sessions of 6 questions each. Each question should be 1-2 sentences, specific, and actionable. Gemini Deep Research will use these questions verbatim.
gemini_3x6_split.template:
Generate 18 research questions for the topic: {{user_query}}

Organize into 3 sessions:
- Session 1 (Foundations): Define concepts, history, core principles
- Session 2 (Techniques): Methods, tools, practical approaches  
- Session 3 (Applications): Best practices, case studies, implementation

Output as JSON with structure:
{
  "session_1": ["q1", "q2", "q3", "q4", "q5", "q6"],
  "session_2": ["q1", "q2", "q3", "q4", "q5", "q6"],
  "session_3": ["q1", "q2", "q3", "q4", "q5", "q6"]
}
